title: "Iris petal length"
author: "Han Bao"
date: "2026-09-21"
---
Data: [iris dataset].

## Load data

```{r}

data <- iris
head(data)
```

## Caculate mean of petal length

```{r}
#| message: false

library(dplyr)

mean_length = data |>
  group_by(Species) |>
  summarise(mean_petal_length = mean(Petal.Length))

mean_length
```


## Compare each species' length range

```{r}
data |>
  group_by(Species) |>
  summarise(
    shortest = min(Petal.Length),
    longest = max(Petal.Length),
    avg = mean(Petal.Length)
  )
```

## Conclusion
Virginica has the longest avg petal length(about 5.55),followed by versicolor(4.26), while setosa has the shortest(about 1.46).
